summary.keyTheme: Record highs on half-day with muted volume. Tesla delivery beat momentum carrying over. ISM Services contraction (48.8) released morning of July 3 creates cross-current. ADP jobs at 150K (soft). Fed Powell at ECB Sintra signaling patience on cuts but acknowledging disinflation. VIX near 12 = extreme complacency. Hurricane Beryl watch for energy. France election first round relief rally in Europe.
summary.halfDayImplications: Thinner liquidity, smaller absolute moves, earlier stops. Institutional desks skeletal ahead of July 4. Momentum trades favored over mean reversion in low-volume tape.
